rules.behavior: Only one right panel. Switching replaces previous panel after its draft/consent cleanup rule.
Do not stop ingestion, disconnect SSH, clear query or resume paused viewport.
Pause viewport, select event and show Inspector; background ingestion continues.
Dismiss topmost popover/modal first, then right panel; restore opener focus. Do not unexpectedly resume live.
Keep source scope, query and viewport state. Release/cancel obsolete auxiliary view jobs; leave source readers active.
Use an overlay sheet with focus trap and accessible dialog semantics; larger screens use nonmodal panel with an accessible region label.
Keep harmless nonsecret fields in memory for this session; do not persist explicit consent or credentials.
Cancel detail jobs and release detail pins/budgets via existing lifecycle.
Clear enrollment secret, credential input and unchecked consent context. Never persist approval as UI preference.
Show exact prepared preview in the same contextual flow, then explicit action/consent. Release prepared preview on cancel; no stacked modal chain.

firstRun: Enter host / import static SSH aliases
Add source: file path or scoped discovery
addSource: Choose file, Docker or systemd source
Optional discovery scope and config consent
failure: Host key / permission / network errors near responsible action
Query parse error without replacing last valid results
Expired event or paused anchor: explain and offer requery/jump to live
Unsaved changes: inline indication; no success toast until confirmed

AI & MCP: Explain Error provider, disabled by default
Service mappings: Notice that changes revoke related grants and contexts

securityInvariants: Keep strict host-key policy and explicit dynamic SSH consent.
Choosing host, path, candidate or Saved View does not start readers or grant access.
Production remains a label, never permission.
Keep separate consent for config reading, external source grants and each explanation.
Preserve export redaction, prepared preview, TTL and explicit overwrite.
Only safe UI preferences may persist; secrets and approvals never do.
statesToSpecifyBeforeCode: No retained logs / no query matches
Settings loading / error / saved / grant revoked
